articles.title: Telegram group at center of Jane Street insider-trading allegations in Terra collapse
articles.snippet: Newly unsealed filings detail a private chat dubbed ‘Bryce’s Secret’ that Terraform’s estate says gave Jane Street an informational edge before UST’s collapse.

articles.title: Meta begins 8K global job cuts, starting in Singapore
articles.snippet: Approximately 49,000 workers were laid off in 2026 as companies adopted a more AI-reliant business model.

articles.title: US Treasury Sanctions Sinaloa Cartel Over Crypto-Fueled Fentanyl Trafficking
articles.snippet: Members linked to the Sinaloa Cartel responsible for turning cash from drug proceeds into crypto were added to the sanctions list.
